title: L'invenzione di Morel
writer: Andrea Barbato, Emidio Greco, Adolfo Bioy Casares
actors: Giulio Brogi, Anna Karina, John Steiner
plot: A castaway arrives on an island. He thinks it's uninhabited, but he sees a palace with also a hidden room. Soon he sees some people walking, dressed with old-fashioned clothes. He is afraid because people don't see him, like a ghost.
